positions.name: FrontlineSequencingPreservedUnderDiagnosticCompression
positions.frame: When diagnostic duration compresses due to frontline participant availability, how is operational-first interview sequencing maintained?
positions.why: Segments src-1 and src-2 cohere around adjusting the Thistlewick diagnostic timeline to eight working days due to warehouse lead availability while deliberately maintaining the invariant that frontline warehouse discovery precedes management interviews.
